children: ALEXANDRIA, Va., Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FirstService Residential, the leading residential community management company, is pleased to announce that three of its managed communities recently participated in the Plug in Alexandria program, including Marina Towers Condominium Association, Northampton Place Condominium, and Parkfairfax Condominium, all located in Alexandria, Virginia.

FirstService Residential, through FirstService Energy, provides advisory and consulting support to help communities identify, pursue, and maximize available incentive opportunities in areas, including New York City, Boston, Toronto, and New Jersey.

Plug in Alexandria is a program to help residents of multi-family communities, including condominiums and apartments, in Alexandria, Virginia, access charging for electrical vehicles (EVs). The program provides expert guidance and financial assistance. Communities accepted into the program receive technical assistance from an industry expert and will be eligible to receive a reimbursement grant of $10,000 to cover a portion of eligible expenses from installing EV chargers.

"Our local teams were proud to work with these communities throughout the process," said Trent Harrison, President, MidAtlantic, FirstService Residential, "EV charging is a great asset for the residents of these communities."

FirstService Energy 360° offers communities a holistic, expert-driven energy management solution that provides management teams and boards with the data intelligence and confidence to make informed decisions for their communities. 360º is designed to simplify energy management, track utility spending, increase efficiency, and identify cost savings, all in one easy-to-manage subscription.

As the leading residential community management company, FirstService Residential collaborates with boards and residents to enhance property values, elevate the resident experience, and deliver tailored solutions that meet the unique needs of every community it serves.

FirstService Residential is simplifying property management. Its hospitality-minded teams serve residential communities across the United States and Canada. The organization partners with boards, owners, and developers to enhance the value of every property and the life of every resident.

Leveraging unique expertise and scale, FirstService serves its clients with proven solutions and a service-first philosophy. Residents can count on 24/7 customer care and tailored lifestyle programming, amenity activation, and technology for their community's specific needs. Market-leading programs with FirstService Financial, FirstService Energy, and special districts teams deliver additional levels of support.
Boards and developers select FirstService Residential to realize their vision and drive positive change for residents in the communities in their trusted care.
